content_sections.heading: About Suri Sadar Sub-Division Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Suri (Sadar) Sub-Division, is a Government of West Bengal office in Birbhum district. It is engaging retired persons as Guest Teachers and Non-Teaching Staff in the Government Model Schools at Rajnagar, Md. Bazar and Dubrajpur until regular staff are selected through the West Bengal Public Service Commission. The engagement is made as per Memo No. 11-SE(S)/3S-28/2009 dated 03.01.2012 of the School Education Department (Secondary Branch), Government of West Bengal, and is done by the Selection Committee headed by the Sub-Divisional Officer as Chairman, Recruitment Committee.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed Application Form, which is available at the office of the Sub-Divisional Officer and on the notice board of each Government Model School. Address the application to: The Chairman, Recruitment Committee & Sub-Divisional Officer, Suri (Sadar) Sub-Division, Birbhum. Collect the prescribed Application Form from the Sub-Divisional Officer's office or the notice board of a Government Model School. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures. Put the application in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of ............ (Subject/Post)". Drop the envelope in the correct application box at the Sub-Divisional Officer's office: one box is for Guest Teacher posts, the other for Group-D and Security Guard posts. Submit between 26/11/2026 and 17/12/2026, up to 5:30 PM. All applications must be submitted through the application boxes kept at the Sub-Divisional Officer's office. Applications sent through the Post Office must also be deposited in the same application box. A separate application is required for each post. Applicants for Guest Teacher (Bengali, English and History) may indicate their preferred schools in order of preference.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 12 vacancies are spread across three Government Model Schools, as printed in the notice: Must be a retired employee from NVF/Ex-Service men/Home Guard. Age must not exceed 62 years as on 01.01.2027. Must be medically fit for day-to-day school support duties, including guarding duties. Persons compulsorily retired as punishment, or charged or convicted of moral turpitude or any criminal offence, will not be considered. Preference will be given to persons who retired from schools or offices within Birbhum district. Preference will be given to teachers with an English-medium background for subjects other than Bengali. The remuneration for all posts is fixed by the same rule: Basic Pay (including Grade pay) on the date of superannuation plus dearness allowances admissible on the date of engagement in the re-employed service, minus the sum total of basic pension before commutation and dearness relief as admissible on the basic pension on the date of engagement as a re-employee pensioner. The notice says the person will draw pension relief on pension as usual. No fixed amount is printed. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-wise eligibility of each Guest Teacher post.

content_sections.heading: Suri Sadar Sub-Division Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Take classes full time, six days a week during school hours. Perform related duties such as invigilation and scrutiny of answer scripts. Day-to-day school support duties: peon work, office delivery, maintenance or cleanliness. Day-to-day school support duties, including guarding duties.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents must be attached to the application: Proof of age. Educational and professional qualification certificates. Retirement order / retirement certificate. Last Pay Certificate & P.P.O. along with the last page of Bank Passbook for pension. Certificate showing that the school or office of retirement was recognised / a Government establishment. Experience certificate, if available. Two recent passport-size photographs. Aadhaar Card or any other valid identity proof.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: document verification, then a Walk-in Interview by the District-level Selection Committee. All candidates must appear in person at the office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Suri (Sadar) Sub-Division, on 18 December 2026 at 11:00 AM with all original certificates and documents. After verification, Admit Cards for the Walk-in Interview will be issued by hand to eligible candidates on the same date. Guest Teacher posts: 29 December 2026, from 11:00 AM onwards. Group-D and Security Guard posts: 30 December 2026, from 11:00 AM onwards. For Guest Teachers, a Master's or higher degree in the relevant subject earns one additional mark (Master's Degree and Ph.D only). No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview. Names of candidates recommended for Guest Teacher will be forwarded to the Commissioner of School Education Department. Names recommended for Group-D and Security Guard will be forwarded to the District Magistrate, Birbhum, for issuance of appointment letters.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Suri Sadar Sub-Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 8 Guest Teacher posts (2 Bengali, 2 English, 2 History, 1 Geography, 1 Mathematics), 3 Group-D posts and 1 Security Guard post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications will be received from 26 November 2026 to 17 December 2026, up to 5:30 PM. Applications received after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The applicant must be a retired teacher of a Government, Government-aided or Government-sponsored school with a Bachelor's degree in the subject applied for and a B.Ed. degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For Guest Teacher posts, the age must not exceed 64 years as on 01.01.2027. For Group-D and Security Guard posts, it must not exceed 62 years as on 01.01.2027.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for the Group-D and Security Guard posts?
faq.answer: Group-D is open to retired regular Government of West Bengal employees retired from a Group-D or equivalent post. Security Guard is open to retired employees from NVF/Ex-Service men/Home Guard.

faq.question: Q6. How will the salary of retired employees be fixed?
faq.answer: Pay is the basic pay (including grade pay) on the date of superannuation plus admissible dearness allowance, minus basic pension before commutation and dearness relief. The pension continues to be drawn as usual.

faq.question: Q7. How do I submit the application?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed Application Form and place it in a sealed, superscribed envelope in the correct application box at the Sub-Divisional Officer's office. Applications sent by post must also be deposited in the same box.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates appear for document verification on 18 December 2026 at 11:00 AM, then a Walk-in Interview: 29 December 2026 for Guest Teachers and 30 December 2026 for Group-D and Security Guard.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is for up to six months or until regular appointees join, whichever is earlier, and may be renewed if posts remain unfilled. No one will be continued beyond 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application is required for each post.
